# akeyless_target_atlassian (Resource)

Atlassian Target resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    akeyless = {
      version = ">= 1.0.0"
      source = "akeyless-community/akeyless"
    }
  }
}


provider "akeyless" {
  api_key_login {
    access_id = ""
    access_key = ""
  }
}

# Atlassian Cloud: a user API token is paired with the account email.
resource "akeyless_target_atlassian" "cloud" {
  name            = "terraform/atlassian-cloud"
  atlassian_url   = "https://<site>.atlassian.net"
  atlassian_email = "<account-email>"
  atlassian_token = var.atlassian_api_token
  description     = "Atlassian Cloud site scanned by Identity & Secrets Intelligence"
}

# Jira Data Center: a personal access token, no email.
resource "akeyless_target_atlassian" "data_center" {
  name            = "terraform/atlassian-dc"
  atlassian_url   = "https://jira.<company>.example/jira"
  atlassian_token = var.atlassian_pat
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `atlassian_token` (String, Sensitive) Atlassian Cloud API token, or Data Center personal access token
- `atlassian_url` (String) Atlassian site base URL (https://<site>.atlassian.net, or a Data Center base URL)
- `name` (String) Target name

### Optional

- `atlassian_automation_key` (String, Sensitive) Optional Automation REST API key (Jira settings > System > Automation > API keys) so the scan can read the automation rules; without it they are reported as not read
- `atlassian_email` (String) Atlassian account email paired with a Cloud API token (not needed for a Data Center personal access token)
- `delete_protection` (String) Protection from accidental deletion of this object [true/false]
- `description` (String) Description of the object
- `keep_prev_version` (String) Whether to keep previous version [true/false]. If not set, use default according to account settings
- `key` (String) Key name. The key will be used to encrypt the target secret value. If key name is not specified, the account default protection key is used.
- `max_versions` (String) Set the maximum number of versions, limited by the account settings defaults

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
